onthisday.description: Napoléon Bonaparte abdicates unconditionally and is exiled to the island of Elba in the Mediterranean.

techmeme.headline: Sam Altman reflects on the attack on his house, OpenAI's success, personal regrets, and advocates for de-escalating rhetoric and tactics in the AI industry
techmeme.context: Sam Altman: — Here is a photo of my family. I love them more than anything. — Images have power, I hope...

techmeme.headline: San Francisco police arrested a suspect for allegedly throwing a Molotov cocktail at Sam Altman's home and also making threats outside OpenAI's headquarters
techmeme.context: An attacker allegedly threw a molotov cocktail at the OpenAI CEO's residence before making threats outside of the startup's headquarters.

techmeme.headline: Sources: Goldman Sachs, Citigroup, and other banks are testing Anthropic's Mythos model internally; JPMorgan Chase is the only bank named in Project Glasswing
techmeme.context: Wall Street banks are starting to test Anthropic PBC's Mythos model internally as Trump administration officials encourage them to use it to detect vulnerabilities.

sciencedaily.headline: Hidden "Drain" Inside the Human Brain
sciencedaily.summary: New MRI scans reveal fluid flows along the middle meningeal artery in a slow, lymphatic-like pattern—distinct from blood flow. Could have major implications for understanding brain waste removal and disease.

bigthink.headline: Why modern physics is forcing us to rethink existence
bigthink.relevance: NASA astronomer Michelle Thaller argues quantum entanglement may be the underlying fabric from which spacetime itself emerges.
